notes.title: First Update Fast Food Never More
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we are launching the first Fast Food Never More update.
In this update we improve the following topics:
- New monster (Fly Burger)
- New BurgerBoss design
- Improved damage system
- Two new scenes
-Fixed bug in Burger Monster's shooting system.

We continue to work to improve your gaming experience.

Thanks

LittleUncleStudio Team
